text:
nora: Hi team — had a tele-visit last week and provider billed, but Anthem denied for 'member not found'. I changed my last name after marriage and updated Workday last week. Do I need a new insurance card? I'm worried the provider will send balance bill.
maya (People Ops): Congrats on the wedding! :tada: Short answer: if Workday update went through but Anthem doesn't yet have the new last name on file, claims can mismatch. Two immediate fixes: 1) Ask the provider to re-submit claim using your Anthem member ID (not name) and include the old name as an AKA; or 2) get Anthem to update member demographic (name) and reissue/redirect the claim.
benefits-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm member ID and DOB stay the same. 2) Upload name change proof (marriage certificate or SSN update) to Benefits Portal -> My Documents. 3) Request Anthem to attach "name update" to claims processing for affected DOS.
nora: I have the scanned marriage certificate and emailed HR. Provider billed under my maiden name — they say they only bill names on their chart. Provider is a small clinic. What's the fastest message I can ask them to include so Anthem doesn't bounce it?
maya (People Ops): Tell the clinic billing to include this in the claim resubmission: 1) Member ID: <ANTHEM_ID> 2) Subscriber name: Nora <NewLastName> 3) Note: "Subscriber previously billed as Nora <OldLastName> (AKA) — member ID unchanged" 4) Attach copy of marriage certificate to claim if portal allows. If they can't attach, include the AKA text in the claim remarks field.
provider-billing: Hi Nora  we can resubmit with AKA in the patient info. We usually put the maiden name in the patient alias field and in the claim remarks. If Anthem still denies, we'll accept a copy of the member ID card or a formal EOB-to-payer correction code. DM bill # and we'll refile.
anthem-support: Hi Nora  we see many denials from name mismatches even with same member ID. Please DM member ID + claim # and we can both: a) update demographics if you upload proof, and b) re-open the claim for reprocessing once name is corrected. If claim was denied as 'member not found', reprocessing after demo update typically resolves it. Turnaround ~7-14 business days.
nora: If Anthem needs a legal document to change name, is a marriage certificate enough or do they require SSN card? I haven't updated SSN yet.
maya (People Ops): Anthem typically accepts a marriage certificate or court order for name change. If they ask for SSN card, call them and ask for exceptions for claims processing while SSN update is pending. Upload the marriage certificate to the Benefits Portal and then DM Anthem support as @anthem-support requested. We'll confirm once Anthem updates it.
benefits-bot: Reminder: Upload documents under Benefits Portal -> My Documents -> Name Change. Also notify People Ops so we can push a verification to the insurer if needed.
provider-billing: One more tip: ask the provider to bill using both subscriber name fields and include your member ID in loop 2010CA (claim format). That extra identifier helps automated matching.
nora: Thanks — I'm uploading the marriage cert now and will DM Anthem + provider bill #. If I paid the copay at visit, should I send receipt too?
maya (People Ops): Yes include the receipt if you paid at time of service — that helps if the claim is reprocessed and a refund is due. If provider balance posts while claim is pending, keep payment proof and we'll help with a refund/adjustment request.
anthem-support: After you DM the member ID and claim number and we receive the doc upload, we'll flag the claim for manual reprocess and note the aka/alias. We'll message you the reprocess ID once started.
nora: Appreciate it. One more question: will I need a new physical card ordered?
maya (People Ops): Anthem will usually reissue a digital and physical card with the updated name. You can also download the member ID from the Anthem app in the meantime and screenshot it for providers. If you need an immediate cover letter from People Ops to show clinic, I can send a verification PDF showing subscriber name, member ID, and effective dates.
nora: Please send the PDF — clinic said they accept staff-sent verification. Thanks everyone!
maya (People Ops): Sending the verification PDF to your work email now and cc'ing the clinic billing address. If Anthem requires additional docs, we'll coordinate. :thumbsup:
provider-billing: Got the verification PDF, we'll use it to re-bill. DM bill # and we'll refile today.
nora: Done, DM'd the bill # and uploaded marriage certificate. Keeping fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
